Package io.jengacode.eduvideo.export

Class ProductionBuilder

java.lang.Object
io.jengacode.eduvideo.export.ProductionBuilder
public final class ProductionBuilder extends Object
Preflight-first production pipeline. Speech is generated, cached, measured and mixed before visual rendering. BGR frames stream directly to FFmpeg, avoiding a huge PNG sequence. Temporary products stay beside the destination and are removed after success, failure or cancellation.

    • build

      public void build(VideoProject project, Path output, ProductionBuilder.Profile profile, Path cacheDirectory, boolean noSpeech, double from, double to) throws Exception
      * Builds a protected MP4 and a report. noSpeech is explicit editorial mode, never a silent fallback.
      Parameters:
      project - validated lesson model, kept unchanged during rendering
      output - destination file or delivery settings, according to this signature
      profile - delivery resolution and frame-rate preset
      cacheDirectory - directory for reusable speech WAV files
      noSpeech - explicit editorial mode omitting narration while preserving music and effects
      from - source position or start of the requested mathematical/render interval
      to - destination position or end of the requested mathematical/render interval
      Throws:
      Exception
